info.name: Bootcamp Tracker API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for Bootcamp Tracker API

Features:
✓ All 50+ API endpoints organized by module
✓ Auto-extraction of tokens and user IDs per role
✓ Role-based authentication (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, SRM, STUDENT)
✓ Pre-configured query parameters for search, filter, pagination
✓ Automated test scripts for validation
✓ Clean variable management

Modules: Auth & OTP, Users, Students, Attendance, Tasks, Call History, Analytics, Email, Dev Tools
